title: Page 10
content_zh:
“姊姊，你好多了吗？要不要吃甜汤？已经五点了，先喝点甜甜的东西垫肚子，六点再吃晚餐。”

“有力气下床吗？要不要去厕所？我抱你。”

看着殷勤讨好的两人，温希琳清楚知道他们是因为争吵气到她而心虚，她不禁又好气又好笑。“你们不吵架了？”

“再也不吵了。”两人异口同声。

那回你来我往的争执不休将温希琳气到早产，痛了十几个小时才生下小孩，本以为母子均安，喂她吃了东西就让她休息，谁知她一睡就睡了二十小时，怎么叫都叫不醒，连起床解决生理需求都没有，真的吓坏了他们，以为温希琳要就此长眠不醒了，赶紧找医生过来。

医生检查后说是因为温希琳身体不好，虽然近一年有改善，但早期长年的健康问题无法根治，生下这个小孩消耗她太多精力和体力，建议好好调养，五年内都不要再怀孕了。

闻言，文景瑞和温希恩都很自责，决定以后都不要吵架了，这种可怕的经验一次就够了，再来一回他们绝对会吓死，也就是这样，现在温希琳才可以看到两人相处融洽的场面。

“你们两个喔……”时间过了太久，温希琳也气不起来了，当时想骂他们的话现在都忘光了。

“姊，以后我保护你。”温希琳突然道。“以后我是你的后盾，你不要再为我做那么大的牺牲了！”没头没脑的说完这句话，她话锋一转，“姊，我的小外甥好可爱喔，你这一星期一直睡睡睡，都还没有抱到他，等下外公派的车要来接我了，我去叫护理人员把小孩带来，我们一起拍照，等等拿给外公看。”

“好啊……等等，你刚刚说什么？外公为什么要派车来接你？希恩，你什么时候和外公这么好了？你之前明明说很讨厌他的啊。”温希琳狐疑的问。

“呃……姊，我去找护理人员，你等等喔！”温希恩一怔，心虚快速闪过她明亮的眼中，故左右而言他后匆匆逃离现场。

“奇怪，发生什么事了？景瑞？”温希琳把视线移到自家老公身上。

“你刚睡醒，先喝点热甜汤。”文景瑞没回答，拿起保温瓶为她倒了一碗甜汤，捧着碗坐到病床床沿，很自然的要喂她。

温希琳眯了眯眼，觉得他脸上多了一个她没见过的东西，她下意识地伸手摸向他的鬓角。

“嘶——”文景瑞痛得倒吸口气。

“你怎么受伤了？！”温希琳瞪大了眼睛。

文景瑞眼见瞒不过，只能说：“你外公拿拐杖打的。”

温希琳大惊。“为什么？因为你跟希恩吵架，让我气到早产？”

“这只是其中一个原因。”文景瑞摸了摸鼻子。“你外公看过小孩了，他三天两头就来看小孩，也很担心你这样睡身体会不会有问题……不过我猜他目前没脸来见你。”

“为什么？”

“因为希恩告诉他我们为什么吵架。”文景瑞苦笑。“你平安生下小孩，我走出产房报平安的时候，你外公的拐杖就往我脸上打过来，他气得要命，气完后接着是自责，怪自己当初没听你把话说完就走，这才让你必须答应我的条件，你外公又想到自己病重时，只有你真心去探望他，他出院后你也为他做这忙那的，不曾记恨，所以他很心疼你，也感到愧疚。”

“为什么这种事情要告诉外公？”温希琳闻言不住皱眉。“你说，希恩还跟外公说了什么？”

这个嘛……温希恩向温祖雄自告奋勇，询问他还想不想要继承人这种事不知道能不能说？

野心勃勃的温希恩让温祖雄欣赏不已，尤其她告诉温祖雄，她想变强，变成姊姊的后盾，所以希望外公教她、帮她，好让她变强大，姊姊就不会再被欺负，因为这样，这一老一少竟然达成了共识，温希恩这几天都被温祖雄接去上课，为接班做准备。

这事文景瑞乐观其成，想着温希琳多一个难缠的保护者也不错，这么一来等于双重保护，不过这事还是等老婆做完月子，体力都恢复后再一个一个让她知道，现在嘛，她还是多休息的好。

“这都怪我，我早该注销那份契约，却一直到上周才想到要跟你提起……若我早一点发现对你的感情，这些事都不会发生。”文景瑞还是对自己没把事情处理好而自责。“幸好你没事。”

温希琳闻言顿时心软了，他担心自己、关心着自己……唉，她是不是太好说话了呀？原本要责备他和妹妹的，可看见他们心虚的模样就觉得他们已经知错了，也就算了。

尤其文景瑞，明明是个精神奕奕、作息正常的人，现在眼下却能看见很明显的黑眼圈，“景瑞，你都没休息？”

文景瑞摇了摇头。“我怕你醒不过来……”晚上他便守在她床边，盯着她的睡颜到天亮。

“你吓坏了吧？”温希琳满眼心疼，她接过他始终捧在手上，打算要亲自喂她的甜汤，一口气喝光后把碗放在床旁的架子上，而后挪了挪身体，空出偌大病床的另一侧，拍拍空位要他躺上来。“我还是满累的，你上来陪我躺一下。”

文景瑞二话不说躺上去，两人面对面，距离极近，姿态亲密。

负责照料小孩的护理人员推着小孩进来时，就看见他们这副恩恩爱爱的画面，不由自主的露出微笑。

“不用起来，这样躺着就好，我把宝宝放在你们两人中间。”护理人员双眼发亮，阻止文景瑞起身抱小孩，她动作轻柔且快速地将出生一周的新生儿放在这对新手爸妈中间。

温希琳这一周睡睡醒醒，基本没看到孩子几眼，看见睡得极熟的孩子，她心都化了，神情一片温柔。

可她想想又发现不对，刚才是希恩说要去请护理人员抱小孩来，那么希恩人呢？

“不好意思，请问我妹妹呢？她怎么没进来？”

“对欸，我看你们恩爱的样子太兴奋，忘了跟你们说温先生派的车子来了，温小姐去上课，要我转告你们一声，说她下了课直接回家，明天再来看文太太和宝宝，不打扰你们一家三口，文太太，有什么需要就按服务铃，我立刻过来。”

那种怪异的感觉让温希琳皱眉头。

“怎么了？”文景瑞问道。

“希恩肯定做了亏心事，否则不会不说一声就溜掉，而且她还突然跟外公那么好……我现在没体力问她，等我月子做完再跟她算帐。”温希琳说完，看着两人中间的小婴儿，脸上露出慈爱的笑容。“啊，希恩出生的时候也这么小、这么软……”

突然，她又想到了什么，强迫自己把眼睛从可爱的儿子身上移开，抬头问文景瑞，“对了，我一直有个疑惑，那些护理人员好像很喜欢看我们两人相处，这是怎么回事呢？”

还记得每次文景瑞下班过来，巡视的护理人员就会暴增两倍，每个人还都带着兴奋的神情观察他们两人的互动，非常奇怪。

“是发生了一些事，不过不怎么重要，等你养好身体再慢慢厘清也不迟，那些小事有比你亲自喂小孩来得重要吗？”文景瑞不认为可以瞒她一辈子，但能瞒多久就瞒多久吧。

若她知道自己成为新闻人物，底都被掀了，还有她跟自己之间令人羡慕的爱情故事，恐怕会又惊又羞，觉得自己不能见人了。
content_en:
"Sister, are you feeling better? Do you want some sweet soup? It's already five o'clock. Let's drink something sweet to fill your stomach first, and then have dinner at six o'clock."

"Do you have the strength to get out of bed? Do you want to go to the bathroom? I'll hold you."

Looking at the two people who were attentive to please, Wen Xilin knew clearly that they felt guilty because they made her angry because of their quarrel. She couldn't help but feel angry and funny."Don't you quarrel anymore?"

"No more quarreling." The two said in unison.

That time, the constant arguments between you and me made Wen Xilin so angry that she gave birth to the baby prematurely. It took more than ten hours of pain before she gave birth to the baby. She thought that the mother and baby were safe, so she fed her and let her rest. Unexpectedly, she slept for twenty hours and couldn't wake up no matter how she screamed. She didn't even get up to meet her physiological needs. They were really frightened. They thought Wen Xilin was going to sleep forever, so they hurried to find a doctor.

After the examination, the doctor said that it was because Wen Xilin was in poor health. Although she had improved in the past year, her early long-term health problems could not be cured. Giving birth to this child consumed too much of her energy and strength. It was recommended that she take good care of herself and not get pregnant again within five years.

Hearing this, Wen Jingrui and Wen Xi'en both blamed themselves and decided not to quarrel in the future. This terrible experience was enough once, and they would definitely be scared to death if they had it again. That's how it is, and now Wen Xilin can see the two of them getting along harmoniously.

"You two..." It had been too long, and Wen Xilin couldn't get angry anymore. She had forgotten all the things she wanted to scold them at that time.

"Sister, I will protect you from now on." Wen Xilin said suddenly."I will be your backing from now on. Don't make such big sacrifices for me again!" After saying this without thinking, she changed the topic and said, "Sister, my little nephew is so cute. You have been sleeping and sleeping this week and you haven't even hugged him yet. When the car sent by grandpa is coming to pick me up, I will ask the nursing staff to bring the child. Let's take pictures together and show it to grandpa."

"Okay... wait, what did you just say? Why did grandpa send a car to pick you up? Sean, when did you and grandpa get so good? You clearly said you hated him before." Wen Xilin asked suspiciously.

"Uh...sister, I'm going to find the nursing staff. Just wait!" Wen Xi'en was startled, and guilt flashed across her bright eyes, so he hurriedly fled the scene.

"Strange, what happened? Jingrui?" Wen Xilin turned her attention to her husband.

"You just woke up, drink some hot sweet soup first." Wen Jingrui didn't answer, picked up the thermos and poured a bowl of sweet soup for her, sat down on the edge of the hospital bed with the bowl in hand, and naturally wanted to feed her.

Wen Xilin squinted her eyes and felt that there was something on his face that she had never seen before. She subconsciously reached out and touched his temples.

"Hiss—" Wen Jingrui gasped in pain.

"Why are you injured?!" Wen Xilin's eyes widened.

Seeing that he couldn't hide it, Wen Jingrui could only say: "Your grandpa beat him with a cane."

Wen Xilin was shocked."Why? Because you quarreled with Sean and made me so angry that I gave birth prematurely?"

"This is just one of the reasons." Wen Jingrui touched his nose."Your grandpa has seen the child. He comes to see the child every two days. He is also worried about whether there will be any health problems with you sleeping like this... But I guess he has no face to see you at the moment."

"Why?"

"Because Sheen told him why we quarreled." Wen Jingrui smiled bitterly."You gave birth to the baby safely. When I walked out of the delivery room to report that I was safe, your grandpa's crutch hit me in the face. He was furious. After he was angry, he blamed himself. He blamed himself for leaving without listening to what you said. That's why you had to agree to my conditions. Your grandpa thought that when he was seriously ill, only you sincerely visited him. After he was discharged from the hospital, you did all the things for him and never held a grudge. So he felt sorry for you and felt guilty."

"Why do you need to tell grandpa about this kind of thing?" Wen Xilin couldn't help but frowned after hearing this."Tell me, what else did Sheen say to grandpa?"

Well... Wen Xi'en volunteered to Wen Zuxiong and asked him if he still wanted an heir. I wonder if he could tell him?

Wen Zuxiong admired the ambitious Wen Xi'en, especially when she told Wen Zuxiong that she wanted to become stronger and become her sister's backing, so she hoped that her grandfather would teach her and help her so that she could become stronger and her sister would not be bullied again. Because of this, the old and the young actually reached a consensus. Wen Xi'en has been taken to class by Wen Zuxiong these days to prepare for taking over.

Wen Jingrui was optimistic about the success of this matter, thinking that it would be good for Wen Xilin to have a difficult protector, which would be double protection. However, it was better to wait until his wife finished confinement and recovered her strength before letting her know one by one. For now, it was better for her to rest more.

"It's all my fault. I should have canceled that contract long ago, but I didn't think of mentioning it to you until last week... If I had discovered my feelings for you earlier, none of these things would have happened." Wen Jingrui still blamed himself for not handling the matter well."Luckily you're okay."

Wen Xilin's heart softened immediately after hearing this. He was worried and concerned about herself... Oh, isn't she too easy to talk to?Originally, I wanted to blame him and his sister, but seeing their guilty looks, I felt that they already knew their mistake, so I let it go.

Especially Wen Jingrui, who is obviously energetic and has a normal schedule, but now he can see obvious dark circles under his eyes, "Jingrui, you haven't even rested?"

Wen Jingrui shook his head."I'm afraid you won't wake up..." He would stay by her bedside at night, staring at her sleeping face until dawn.

"Are you scared?" Wen Xilin's eyes were full of heartache. She took the sweet soup that he always held in her hand, intending to feed it to her personally. After drinking it all in one breath, she put the bowl on the shelf next to the bed, then moved her body to free up the other side of the huge hospital bed, patted the empty space and asked him to lie down on it."I'm still very tired. Come up and lie down with me."

Wen Jingrui lay down on him without saying a word, and the two of them faced each other, very close to each other, and their gestures were intimate.

When the nurse who was responsible for taking care of the child pushed the child in, he saw their loving scene and couldn't help but smile.

"You don't have to get up, just lie down like this. I'll put the baby between you two." The nurse's eyes lit up and she stopped Wen Jingrui from getting up to pick up the baby. She gently and quickly placed the one-week-old newborn between the new parents.

Wen Xilin had slept in and out of sleep this week and barely saw her child. When she saw her sleeping child, her heart melted and her expression was gentle.

But when she thought about it, she realized something was wrong. Just now, it was Sheen who said that she was going to ask a nursing staff to bring the baby. So what about the people from Sheen?

"Excuse me, where is my sister? Why didn't she come in?"

"Yes, I was so excited seeing your loving look that I forgot to tell you that the car sent by Mr. Wen is here. Miss Wen is going to class. She wants me to tell you that she will go home directly after class and come back to see Mrs. Wen and the baby tomorrow. I won't disturb your family of three. Mrs. Wen, if you need anything, just ring the service bell and I will come right away."

That weird feeling made Wen Xilin frown.

"What's wrong?" Wen Jingrui asked.

"Xian must have done something wrong, otherwise she wouldn't have run away without saying anything, and she was suddenly so good to grandpa... I don't have the energy to ask her now, and I will settle the accounts with her after I finish my confinement." After Wen Xilin finished speaking, she looked at the little baby between the two, with a loving smile on her face."Ah, Sean was so small and soft when he was born..."

Suddenly, she thought of something again and forced herself to look away from her lovely son. She looked up and asked Wen Jingrui, "By the way, I have always had a doubt. Those nursing staff seem to like watching us get along. What's going on?"

I still remember that every time Wen Jingrui came over after get off work, the number of nursing staff on patrol would triple. Everyone would observe their interaction with excitement, which was very strange.

"Something happened, but it's not very important. It won't be too late to figure it out after you get better. Are those little things more important than feeding the child yourself?" Wen Jingrui didn't think he could hide it from her for the rest of his life, but he could hide it for as long as he could.

If she knew that she had become a news figure and had been exposed, as well as the enviable love story between her and herself, I am afraid she would be shocked and ashamed, and feel that she could not see anyone anymore.
